2601. Nothing to become The human in me tells me: I want to be. The divine in me tells me: I can be Because I want to be. The Supreme in me tells me: I have nothing to become For I am already God’s Eternity’s Satisfaction-Fruit.
2602. Take the tempest out My Lord, Do take my mind Out of the tempest. “My child, Let Me take the tempest Out of your mind first.”
2603. What is precious? My dedicated oneness-heart. What is not precious? My accumulated ego-strength.
2604. I need your heart My Lord, my Lord, I need Your Heart. Therefore, I love Your Eye. “My child, My child, I love your heart. Therefore, I need your life.”
2605. Who says that God forgets? Who says that God remembers Everything? Does He remember My animal past? Everything? Does He forget My heart’s gratitude-bud?
2606. I was unprepared I was unprepared for two things: My mind’s illumination-dream And My heart’s perfection-cry.

2607. I shall not interrupt you My Lord said to me: “I shall not interrupt you, My son. Say whatever you want to say.” I said to Him: “I shall not interrupt You, Father. Give me whatever You want to give.”
2608. One thing wrong There is just one thing wrong In my life: My Lord is still missing, Missing inside my imagination-sky.
2609. I do not know My Lord, I love You. But I do not know How deep my love is. My Lord, I need You. But I do not know How sincere my need is.
2610. A free access I just want to tell you About the illumination inside my mind. The beautiful thing about it is, It has a free access To the ultimate Goal.

2611. Duty comes first My Lord, duty comes first In Your Life. Therefore, I love You And I am dying to make You My own. My Lord, pleasure comes first In my life. Therefore, I hate myself And I am desperately trying To disown myself.
2612. Your arms are for extension My Lord, Your Arms are for extension, To extend towards me. My arms are for perfection, To fight for perfection In my outer life.
2613. My Lord loves me Because My mind is not confused, My Lord loves me powerfully. Because My heart asks me who I am, My Lord loves me proudly.
2614. When we share our struggles My heart, When you and I share our struggles, We at once reduce Our imperfection-height And increase Our perfection-length.
2615. My meditation tells me My short meditation tells me: God can and does see me All the time. My long meditation tells me: I can and will see God If I really and desperately want to.
2616. Think of others Think of others. Your heart will be pleased With you. Free others from your snare. Your God will be pleased With you.
2617. No and yes Say “No” When you have to; Say “Yes” When you want to. This is how you can succeed In your world of self-dedication. This is how you can proceed In your world of self-illumination.
2618. Aspiration is an achievement In the world that evolves. Realisation is an achievement In the world that eternally is.

2619. Two needed friends Purity, my needed friend, Where have you been for so long? Humility, my needed friend, Where have you been for so long? Now that you two have come back to me, Please do not desert me. I shall in every way Feed your inner hunger.
2620. The warmth of your realisation-sun The flow of your inspiration-river Is surprising. The glow of your aspiration-mountain Is astonishing. Is fulfilling.

2621. No more advice Please, no advice, outer world! My mind, which is my inner world, Constantly advises me. If I accept its advice, I suffer. If I do not accept its advice, I suffer. My mind is enough To torment me, O world. I need no more advice from anyone, Anywhere.

2622. Originality There is another reason Why I do not admire mankind. Most people are afraid of originality. They do not dare to embrace newness. For me, originality Is the blossoming and fulfilling reality Of tomorrow’s dawn, Which embodies God-Satisfaction Here on earth And There in Heaven.
2623. I love the pristine beauty Of a flower-flame. I love the pristine purity Of a flower-lamp. I love the pristine reality Of a flower-life.
2624. He is already occupied He is already occupied. Do you know what he is occupied with? He is occupied, Consciously and constantly, With one desire, And that is the desire for God.
2625. Renounce, renounce! If you do not renounce, Then your dark attachment-world Will, without fail, Either in the near future Or in the distant future, Drown your stupendous glory.
2626. He has divorced three things He has divorced three things: His old futile reasons. His doubtful poison-mind. His over-estimated confidence-personality.
2627. Earth cannot answer Why he does not And cannot smile. Heaven cannot answer Why he does not And cannot unburden himself. God does not want to answer What he does With his insecurity-heart.
2628. If you want to please a false God If you want to please a false god, Then you do not have to go far. In fact, you do not have to go anywhere. Start pleasing your noble self Right away.
2629. Your imperfection-repetition I do not mind. Do you know why? Because I am breathlessly in love With your heart-nest And also with your soul-bird.
2630. Few in number They are few in number Who listen to God. They are fewer in number Who partially satisfy God. They are fewest in number Who try to unburden God.
2631. Be conscious of your strength Be conscious of your outer strength. You will be divinely powerful. Be conscious of your inner strength. You will be supremely peaceful.
2632. You have sailed a long way If you are aware of the fact That you are in trouble with yourself, Then you have already sailed a long way Towards the Golden Shore.
2633. How can I stop destroying myself? My Lord, “My child, Empty your mind to house Me, Purify your heart to spread Me.”
2634. Your lack of outer wealth Has made you sad. Alas! Your desire for outer wealth Is making you bad. Alas, alas! Your possession of outer wealth Will turn you mad. Alas, alas, alas!

2635. Turning on the switch O my mind, You are failing me mercilessly. Therefore, I am turning off The switch. O my heart, You want to tutor me affectionately, Plus free of charge. Therefore, I am turning on The switch.
2636. My mind's trial period Tomorrow shall mark the end Of my mind’s trial period. My aspiration-heart Shall be the judge. Its verdict Unquestionable shall remain.
2637. The lives of arguments end The lives of all arguments end Only where the heights of truth Remain unparalleled.
2638. My great days Mean my inspiring days. My good days Mean my pure days. My dull days Mean my unaspiring days. My dark days Mean my defeated days.
2639. Make your choice Make your choice: Either cherish anger towards others And perish, Or liberate yourself totally From others. If you make the right choice, You are bound to be happy.
2640. A soulful smile In the inner world Is a guide. In the outer world Is a blessing.
2641. Wisdom-sun Knowledge-sun Is the explanation Of all things. Is the perfection Of all things.
2642. Who will lead you? Will you reform yourself? If you can do so, You will move along The road of perfection. And who will lead you? You know! God the Satisfaction.
2643. The fountain of forgiveness God has already given you A most precious thing: The fountain of goodness. Now He will be giving you The most precious thing: The fountain of forgiveness.
2644. Another name for man Impatience Is another name for man. Therefore, How can he enter The garden of Infinity’s delight?
2645. The lamp of faith You cannot force faith Into a man’s mind. You can only tell him That his heart’s home of peace He will never discover Unless he constantly burns Within himself.
2646. He knows the secrets of Heaven Because His mind is now All attention, His heart is now All obedience And his life is now All willingness.
2647. An atom-weight of goodness Has helped him shake off The heaviest weight Of self-deception and life-imperfection.
2648. God will wait for you With patience-light, Only if you are willing To abide by His Will, Even in the evening of your life.

2649. If you do not know the truth If you know the truth, You will not be questioned. If you do not know the truth, You will be not only tortured By your superiors But also ridiculed By your inferiors.

2650. Two supreme Realities Do not descend from Heaven After me. My heart will feel miserable. Do not descend from Heaven Before me. God will not appreciate it. God has two supreme Realities: Togetherness-life And Oneness-heart.

2651. The splendour of the firmament My mind will be able to climb To its appointed heights And feed itself With the splendour of the firmament Only when it plays the role Of the preserver-smile And not the role Of the destroyer-laughter.
2652. The road of a defeated life If you live In the chaos of thought And in the market of temptation, Then fear will chase you Along the road of a defeated life.
2653. False discoveries So little to love, So much to be loved! So little to give, So much to receive! Indeed, these false discoveries Have marked the end Of humanity’s progress.
2654. Every day I water Heaven With the tears of my heart So that I can live My beautiful, soulful And powerful childhood Once again.
2655. His Eternity's Sunrise Last night my Lord Supreme Secretly came, Secretly stole away My night of desire And secretly left His Eternity’s Sunrise Inside my heart For me to use in my own way.
2656. If truth comes first In your life, Then you do not have to Explain anything to the world, For your eyes become The explanation of all things Big and small.
2657. Unless you reform yourself And enjoy the fruits Of transformation-light, You will deny your mind And rebel against your vital.
2658. God does not forget! You will be questioned. Before you Will be God the Frustration. Behind you Will be God the Destruction.
2659. A new hunger-dawn My desires have destroyed me. My doubts have destroyed me. I am troubled constantly by fears. I must invent a new hunger-dawn In my life.
2660. Unconditional Forgiveness My heart knows, My mind knows not. My heart knows When it is disobedient to God. My mind does not know That God can be unconditional Forgiveness.
2661. You can conquer fate Who says that there Is no weapon against fate? You can conquer your fate If you sow the seed of patience And Reap the fruit of will.
2662. Make the right choice Either love your big dream Or surrender to your small reality. If you want to be permanently happy.
2663. He has renewed himself His mind and heart. His mind will have A timeless extension of vastness. His heart will have A boundless expansion of oneness.

2664. Supreme discoveries In the morning My supreme discovery is: “I am, therefore I think.” In the evening My supreme discovery is: “I think, therefore I am.” In the morning God tells me His own supreme discovery: “I am, therefore I love.” In the evening God tells me His own supreme discovery: “I love, therefore I am.”
2665. Inside a sweet dream I see a perfection-ascending man. Inside a clear reality I see a Satisfaction-descending God.
2666. What follows a man of silence? Eternity’s perfection-train. What follows Eternity’s perfection-train? Immortality’s roaring and reigning lion.

2667. One unforgivable mistake Since you want to know the truth, I am telling you that I have made Only one unforgivable mistake Which I am unable to rectify, And that is: I do not want to unlearn The information my mind has given me Over the years.
2668. Fill the heart Empty the mind! Lo and behold, Right in front of you There is a fountain of peace. Fill the heart! Lo and behold, Right in front of you There is a fountain of bliss.
2669. Each blazing warrior-soul Is God in preparation For His own ever-transcending Self Inside the Satisfaction-Dream Of His ever-transcending Vision-Reality.

2675. The tears of my heart Have decreased my journey’s length And increased my God-hunger For God in God Himself.
2676. Rich and poor He is at once rich and poor. His heart is soulfully rich Before God’s Vision-Eye. His mind is powerfully poor Before God’s Reality-Day.
2677. Truth never descends Truth never descends. Truth never compromises. Truth is satisfied only when It sees everything and everyone At its own Himalayan height.
2678. Man's honesty-boat Man’s honesty-boat, Earth’s appreciation-river, God’s Satisfaction-Shore: These three live for one another.

2680. O my aspiration-child O my aspiration-child, I know, I know You will always succeed In winning the Perfection-Eye And Satisfaction-Heart Of our Beloved Supreme.
2681. The world loves to examine The world loves to examine me. I love to examine My tomorrow’s goal. God loves to examine His own Perfection-Seed inside me.

2683. Drown your glory Drown your own glory If you want a life of peace. Frown at your own victory If you want a heart of delight.

2687. You have accomplished something Once you know that enthusiasm Is the immediate neighbour of lethargy, Then you have really accomplished something Great and good In your life of alertness And your heart of willingness.
2688. O my beautiful hope-soul Hope, O my beautiful hope-soul, You are always celestial. Reality, O my hard reality-body, You are always terrestrial.
2689. Gratitude is something in our heart That helps us Transcend our experience of earth And Intensify our realisation of God.
2690. What I call enthusiasm What I call my own enthusiasm, God calls His own Self-expression. What I call my own sincerity, God calls His own Self-perfection.
2691. My self-transcendence-life My prayer-life Is my sound-life. My meditation-life Is my silence-life. My surrender-life Is my self-transcendence-life.

2693. God and I shall call it Yesterday I called it My inspiration. Today I am calling it My Lord’s instruction. Tomorrow God and I shall call it Our Satisfaction-Manifestation.
2694. I claim I claim and I claim. In the inner world I claim God’s Acceptance-Sea. In the outer world I claim Man’s renunciation-waves.
2695. Your prayers are important Only if you think That God is important in your life. God is important Only if you think That you are important to your soul.
2696. God cares for you If you are apt to think That you have problems, Can you not be apt to think Something more: Beyond your imagination’s flight.

2697. One thing more My Lord, You are telling me That I am free. Needless to say, I am happy to hear that. My Lord, if You really want To make me happier than the happiest, Then do tell me one thing more Once and for all: “My child, you are forgiven.”
2698. Have faith Have faith in yourself. You will have a new heart of assurance. Have faith in God. You will have a new life of accomplishment.
2699. My Lord strengthened My aspiration. My Lord guides My realisation. My Lord shall direct My satisfaction.

1202. If you have the sincerity-courage To declare that you are weak, Then God has the Compassion-Capacity To make you strong.

1203. Unlearn and learn Anything that binds you, Unlearn it. Anything that blinds you, Unlearn it. Anything that limits you, Unlearn it. Anything that awakens you, Learn it. Anything that liberates you, Learn it. Anything that fulfils you, Learn it.
1204. If your mind is divinely practical And If your heart is supremely sensible, Then you can do everything Cheerfully, easily and perfectly.
1205. The deeper you descend In your meditation, To see your source, The clearer becomes Your light-road.
1206. Two things unthinkable A doubting mind Does two things unthinkable: First it secretly betrays you, And then it openly tells you How much it has been helping you All along.

1207. God's Way If God’s Way Is the right way, Then my way too Can be the right way. How? Just by following sleeplessly God’s Way. Since God’s Way Is not so difficult, Then let me surrender My way to God’s Way. Then my way immediately becomes As easy as God’s Way, God’s perfect Way.
1208. If you can brave the shock Of discovering that you are not the person You thought yourself to be, Then you are already on the road To self-recovery, Leading To self-discovery-kingdom.
1209. We realise the highest Truth Only when we are fully prepared To renounce the hungry cry Of our desire-life.
1210. Your destructive impurity Be careful! Can easily disguise itself As creative purity.
1211. A new intensity Will easily save my life. A new immensity Can gloriously fulfil my heart.
1212. I need God I need God. Can you not pray for me? God wants you. Can I not go instead of you?
1213. Conceal your self-interest-cry Conceal your self-interest-cry. God’s Satisfaction-Smile Will, in no time, Enlighten you.
1214. Your heart's name Stark frustration is your heart’s name, Simply because you want to see God’s Satisfaction-Delight Only on your terms.
1215. Why do you need another enemy? Why do you need another enemy, As if your own usual self Is not enough? Why do you need another friend, As if your constant Companion, God, Is not enough?
1216. Ask your mind to protect itself Before it thinks of protecting you. Ask your heart to protect you While it is protecting itself.

1217. Do you know why? You do not want to dominate others? You do not want to dominate others Because you are amazingly strong. You do not blame others? You do not blame others Because your heart-life is flooded With the qualities of sainthood.
1218. The book of self-knowledge You have nothing to do, you say. I tell you, Just study the book of self-knowledge. You will become The greatness-mind And The goodness-heart.
1219. The only wall The only wall that stands Between you and God Is the wall of your false And unfounded Imagination-night.
1220. One day you will see That God and His endless Compassion Never interfered With you and your hungry desire-life.
1221. Your volley of questions Are you ready With your volley of questions? God has already left with me All the answers.

1222. Your heart will get satisfaction Why do you hide your impurity-mind From your purity-heart? Do you not know that your heart Will get tremendous satisfaction By purifying and illumining Your impurity-mind?
1223. A peace-flooded home Your artificial strength Is a haunted house. Your real strength Is a peace-flooded home.
1224. God's creative ability God has already given you What He has: His creative ability. Can you not give God What you have: Your cherished inability?
1225. God's Assembly-skies Have faith in your yet unawakened powers. Someday they will be awakened, Fully awakened, And then they will help you become A distinguished member Of God’s Assembly-skies.

1226. How can you expect? Your body is all temptation. Your vital is all deception. Your mind is all illusion. How can you expect your heart To be all perfection? How can you expect your soul To be all satisfaction? How can you expect God To grant you a new creation?
1227. God will find you the way If you sincerely admit That you are lost in the quagmire of life, Then God will definitely find you the way, The sunlit way, To return Home.
1228. If you come to me now If you come to me now, I shall immediately show you The Vision-Eye of God. If you do not come, I shall show you The orphan-tears Of your complete failure-life.
1229. What can you expect? What can you expect from a world That loves beauty’s deception Infinitely more Than duty’s perfection And God’s Satisfaction?
1230. A boat that knows no shore Alas, alas, You and I are sailing In a boat that knows no shore. You are your self-deception And I am my self-glorification.

1231. The contradiction-sky The contradiction-sky exists. Why? Because your God is in your doubtful mind And my God is in my baneful tongue. The contradiction-sky will disappear The moment your God and my God Live happily in our soulful hearts.
1232. You need an explanation-life You need an explanation-life. I need a revelation-life. God needs for you and me His Eternity-Infinity’s Compassion-Life.
1233. Each senseless thought Is a useless life. Each useless life Is a godless failure.
1234. Even so As water cannot be dry, Even so, Your heart cannot be dry. As a thief can empty your wallet, Even so, Your mind can empty The joy of your life-vessel.
1235. If I can see God's Face If I can see God’s Face Even once, I am sure He will make Some room for me To stay in His Heart As long as I want to.
1236. When I am sincerity incarnate When I am sincerity incarnate, I try to save my life from myself. When I am insincerity incarnate, I proudly dare to save The entire world.
1237. Do not trust Do not trust the animal in you, For it is dangerous. Do not trust the human in you, For it is treacherous. Do trust the divine in you, For it is always harmonious, Plus gracious.
1238. Just relax! Relax, just relax! Lo, to your wide astonishment Your cruel difficulties Are also relaxing with you. They feel that they rightly Deserve some rest.

1239. Something really valuable If you really want something really valuable, Then get rid of the thing That is worthless and useless in your life. What is really valuable? A heart in its faith-home. What is worthless and useless? A mind in its doubt-cave.
1240. He is a real danger to himself Who thinks that God needs him desperately. His danger is imminent If he thinks that God needs him Infinitely more than he needs God.

1244. I shall not choose I shall not choose. Therefore, I shall not lose. I shall not lose. Therefore, I can now smile like a morning rose And an evening star.
1245. A perfectly celestial smile What you are now Is an artificially mechanical cry. What I want you to be Is a perfectly celestial smile.
1246. Do not be disappointed! God-Discovery is not an impossible task. He has done it. Even I have done it. You, too, will do it before long.
1247. Two incredible facts Two incredible facts: God was chasing my desire-tiger. My doubting mind was untiringly Following God.
1248. Yours is the mind That uses fear to exploit you. Yours is the heart That uses love to glorify you.
1249. Go alone! Go alone, go alone! God has been waiting for you For a long time. Go alone, go alone! God will never ask you To account for others.
1250. A relief to discover What a relief to discover At long last That I can easily live outside The ruthless desire-snare.
1251. Companions Your mind’s hesitation And your heart’s frustration Will always be found together.
1252. Do not complain Do not complain, do not complain! Are you a prisoner? Do not explain, do not explain! Who has accused you? Nobody.
1253. Your life is not your own Your life is not your own. Why do you look around and move around? Don’t you know that Your life is God’s own Treasure-Bliss?
1254. Sacrifice what you have Sacrifice immediately what you have For what you can have, If you are truly wise. What you have Is endless ignorance-night. What you can have Is sleepless God-Delight.
1255. Peace needs no interpretation Peace needs no interpretation. Love needs no explanation. Oneness needs no revelation.

1257. Do you really want to be happy? Then discourage your anxiety-life. Do you really want to be perfect? Then sleeplessly claim God as your own, Very own.

1259. God's Compassion-Eye God’s Compassion-Eye Is my journey’s eternal map. God’s Forgiveness-Heart Is my journey’s eternal strength.
1260. How can you be happy? When you have chosen yourself To be your sole advisor? How can you blame God When you have declared yourself To be another God?
1261. Soaring wings O my dying mind, I tell you, You do not have to die. Just agree to sit On the soaring wings of my heart.
1262. My heart's aspiration-light Sweet is my heart’s Aspiration-light. Sweeter is my life’s Dedication-height. Sweetest is my soul’s Perfection-delight.
1263. Your love of soul-freedom Your constant love of soul-freedom Indicates that you are Of God the One And For God the many.
1264. Self-control Self-control means wisdom-light. Wisdom-light drinks deep the delight Of the ever-transcending Beyond.
1265. Each dream Each dream is a hunger-need. This hunger-need is The beginning of a new life And The end of an old death.

1272. Each service-heart Sculptures the perfection-beauty Of tomorrow’s self-transcending New world.
1273. Fight against complacency Fight bravely, fight Against complacency! Your victory-splendour Will never be preceded By the flaming arrows Of anxiety-night.
1274. His life's ignorance-chain When he broke his life’s ignorance-chain, He broke it for all his fellow-travellers Who sail with him in the Golden Boat With the Himalayan aspiration-cry.
1275. If you have perfect faith In the weight of your soul’s Tremendous influence, Then your aspiration-dedication Is bound to succeed triumphantly And proceed sleeplessly.
1276. Life-satisfying energy-blossoms Put back your faith On your heart’s throne. Yours will be the inexhaustible Life-satisfying energy-blossoms.

1278. His heart thrives on adversity His heart thrives on adversity. His life thrives on austerity. His soul thrives on prosperity.
1279. Every step of progress-smile My every step of progress-smile Helps my world within And my world without To reach my Lord’s Satisfaction-Heart.

1281. My self-examination I call it My self-examination. God calls it His Self-Satisfaction.

1287. A dedicated God-believer Can never be frustrated. A dedicated God-lover Can never fail.
1288. Fools O my tiny desires, Why are you such fools? Why do you not try to grow Into brighter than the brightest Aspiration-flames?
1289. Two royal paths A doubting mind And a strangling vital Are unquestionably two royal paths Leading to complete destruction-death.
1290. A dangerous trap When I do not aspire, A dangerous trap of ignorance-night Captures my outer joy And destroys my inner poise.
1291. Someday my Lord will give me The heart that knows How to pray sleeplessly And How to meditate unconditionally.
